caption: The drawing depicts a wooden bust of a woman, rendered in earth-toned shades predominantly consisting of browns, tans, and muted greens. The bust is shown from the chest up, featuring detailed carvings of facial features, hair, and clothing. The woman’s hair is pulled back in a bun, with carved details indicative of individual strands and gathered sections. Her face is frontal, showing carved eyes, nose, mouth, and chin, with visible wood grain and cracks throughout the surface indicating age. The attire displays ornate details such as a laced bodice and sleeves with circular fastenings. The lower edge of the bust has carved elements that resemble rounded forms or decorative motifs. The wood appears weathered, with visible splits, chips, and texture marked by subtle green discoloration, suggesting lichen or moss growth. The background of the drawing is a plain, light beige color, with no additional objects present.
title: Figurehead
